t: This is the Royal Academy War Memorial, at the Royal Academy of Arts. Several hands made it. Trenwith Wills, an architect, designed it. The sculptural work was by two sculptors: Herbert Tyson Smith, an English sculptor born in Liverpool who made many war memorials around Liverpool and Merseyside, and Emile Alfred Madeline, a French sculptor. Take a moment to look at how the architecture and the sculpture work together in this memorial.
